name: core-lazy
title: Core: poster-first scenes
description: sg-lazy wraps a poster (a picture in AVIF, WebP and JPG) and a hidden sg-scene. The poster is the first paint and reads with no JavaScript; the scene's engine and module are fetched only when the element is near the screen, and never by itself under reduced motion, Save-Data, the quiet register or a low-memory device, where the poster stays as the finished still. start() runs it for a viewer who asks. The decision is a pure function (lazy.core.js), and the styles are a constructable sheet, so a strict Content-Security-Policy has nothing to block.

budget.reason: The element (about 5 KB with its comments) and its pure core (about 3 KB), counted together. The point of the piece is that it is small: a page holding only a poster fetches this and nothing of the engine.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
